text: Filed from the chief's acceptance of 866e493 (route:transition-direction), which deliberately scoped itself to DIRECTION AGREEMENT between adjacent units and said so. What it explicitly does not cover, in m1's own words and preserved here so the boundary is not forgotten: it will not distinguish a two-step reversal from a five-step one, and it says nothing about revisits or compression. The vision's second question names jumps, reversals, REVISITS and COMPRESSION; direction agreement covers the first two only. Open questions for whoever takes this: does a revisit metric need a gold notion of 'returned to a place already visited', and is that the same relation as the interview module's digression-return rule (explicit marker OR lost-digression-continuity AND target-continuity)? If so the two should share a definition rather than drift apart, which is the same argument that produced the shared VisibleAncestorChain helper in view. Compression may already be partly served by RecallSignature, but note the trap m1 identified: signature panels are computed from the INFERRED result alone with no gold comparison, so they describe what a channel produced rather than whether it matches what the person did. Any compression metric here must be gold-relative or it repeats that error. P3, unassigned.
